newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine economic affairs under-secretary resigns.
newsitem.headline: Argentine economic affairs under-secretary resigns.

text.p: Argentina's under-secretary for legal affairs at the Economy Ministry Carlos Tombeur has resigned, said the ministry on Friday, according to news agencies.
Tombeur, who resigned to persue private business, will be replaced by Miguel Angel Pareja, said state news agency Telam.
The under-secretary was a part of former Economy Minister Domingo Cavallo's economic team.
